test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**cause**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **root cause** is a factor that causes a particular situation.
 
• Here in the passage which is based on environment in the lines, this is the **root **cause of air, water and land pollution on the planet. the word tries to explain the factors which causes air, water and land pollution.
 
• Hence the correct word is '**cause**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's look at the other options:

 
• **Source**: a place, person or thing where something comes or starts from or where something is obtained.(स्‍थान,उद्‌गम, प्रारंभ या प्राप्ति का बिंदु हो; स्रोत, उद्‌गम, मूल).

 
• **Origin**: the beginning or cause of something (मूल, उद्भव, उत्पत्ति).
 
• **Motive**: a reason for doing something (उद्देश्य कारण प्रयोजन).

52:T906,

The correct answer is '**wonders**'.
